The '''Var Hagen sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]]. The [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]] ended in this sector.
